observations.why: Ratification language performs the settling of the contract; the declarative act records the decision as made, not merely argued for.

evidence.quote:
No blocking
call, and no lost work

observations.why: Operational rules stated as invariants the contract guarantees — 'no blocking call, no lost work' — the speaker treats these as settled constraints the system is built on, not positions to defend.

evidence.quote:
remember dispatches, then the agent either polls the run or
gets the reaction piggybacked on a later call.

observations.why: A flat unhedged assertion of how the mechanism works — asserted and ready to defend, but describing behavior rather than ratifying a settled decision.
